Usage: backfill-series-chains [OPTIONS]

  One-shot walker that splits keys holding unrelated postings under one cover
  title, by writing `patch_series_head_id`. Run it after any `backfill-patch-
  series` run (until #824).

Options:
  --limit INTEGER  Cap the number of articles examined this session.
  --reprocess      No effect: every run chains whole keys afresh and writes only
                   the heads that change.
  --restart        Discard an unfinished run of this backfill and start again
                   from the newest article. A run that has examined articles is
                   kept unless --yes is also given. Without --restart, an
                   interrupted run resumes.
  --yes            With --restart, discard an unfinished run that has progress
                   instead of refusing.
  -v, --verbose    -v: progress hint (broker mode logs to the broker process;
                   use `podman logs -f mimir-broker` to follow).
  --help           Show this message and exit.
